capture.final_message:
Use set extensionality and reduce both identities to propositional membership statements.

- For `sInter {s} = s`, show pointwise that belonging to every set in the singleton `{s}` is equivalent to belonging to `s`.
- For the second identity, membership reduces to
  \[
  x\in s \land (\forall i,\ x\in t_i)
  \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
  \forall i,\ (x\in s\land x\in t_i).
  \]
  The forward direction distributes the conjunction. For the reverse direction, choose an index using `Nonempty ι`; its conjunct yields `x ∈ s`, while each indexed conjunct yields `x ∈ t i`.

The nonemptiness assumption is essential: for an empty index type, the right-hand intersection is universal, whereas the left-hand side is `s`.
